home.intro_text1: Coffee Bar Che is more than a place to drink coffee. It is a space full of energy, music, and conversations that never end. With a spirit of freedom and an alternative atmosphere, Che has been a favourite of people in Skopje for more than a decade.
home.intro_text2: We offer specialty coffees, unique cocktails, and homemade pastries in a warm, retro room across from Universal Hall.
home.about_flip_text: Located in the heart of Skopje, Café Bar Che is more than just a place to enjoy a coffee or a drink — it is a place built around character, creativity, and connection.

home.about_story_p1: Located in the heart of Skopje, Café Bar Che is more than just a place to enjoy a coffee or a drink — it is a place built around character, creativity, and connection. Since opening its doors around 2015, Che has developed its own distinctive identity through its eclectic retro atmosphere, music, and welcoming spirit.
home.about_story_p2: Every corner reflects a love for the past, bringing together unique details and a relaxed ambience that invites people to slow down, connect, and create memories. Over the years, the journey has been shaped by countless moments, challenges, changes, and the people who have made Che part of their everyday lives.
home.about_story_p3: Celebrating nine years of existence, the bar has continued to preserve its individual character and its place in Skopje’s social scene.
home.radio_subtitle: Music is part of Che’s DNA. Follow us for new playlists every week.

home.feature4_desc: A retro interior and a warm setting for every occasion.

about.title: Our story
about.story_p1: Coffee Bar Che opened more than a decade ago with the idea of a space that brings people together. Inspired by the spirit of freedom and the alternative scene, Che became a legendary spot in Skopje — across from Universal Hall, on Kosturski Heroi.
about.story_p2: The name reflects our ideology — to be bold, different, and authentic. Che is not just a coffee bar; it is a community of people who believe in simple moments: good coffee, good music, good company.
about.story_p3: Today Che remains a place of meetings, inspiration, and unforgettable evenings. Welcome to our world.
about.founded_note: Over 10 years of coffee, music, and friends
about.value1_desc: Every detail at Che is chosen with care — from the interior to the coffee. No compromise on quality.
about.value2_desc: Che is a meeting point for people who love conversation, music, and art. Everyone is welcome.
about.value3_desc: We work with local suppliers and try to have a positive impact on our community.

privacy.title: Privacy & cookies
privacy.intro: This page explains what data Coffee Bar Che collects and how we use it. The text is written for a course project and follows good consent practice.
privacy.cookies_text: We only use technical storage in your browser: language preference (che-lang) and cookie consent (che-cookies-consent). We do not embed advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
privacy.type1: Necessary — language and consent, so the site works as you expect.
privacy.type2: Marketing / analytics — not used on this site.
privacy.data_text: When you send a message or a reservation, we use your name, email, phone, and text only to reply. Data is not sold or shared with third parties.
privacy.rights_text: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. Write to hello@kafebarche.mk. You can change consent at any time via the Cookies link in the footer.
